New event; older versions accept the listener but never fire it.
New context-level mirrored events; older versions accept listeners but never fire them.
New getByRole option; older versions ignore the unknown option.
New toHaveCSS option; older versions ignore it and read the element's own style.
New method and a style option on highlight(); calling the new method on older versions throws.

New connectOverCDP option; older versions ignore it and still apply defaults.

onError now receives an extra workerInfo argument for fixture teardown errors.
New template token; older versions leave it unreplaced, producing a different path.
Configs overriding a non-option fixture or using workers 0/negative now error.
show-report now accepts .zip files; older versions fail on a zip path.
Trace Viewer UI toggle with no effect on code, config, or commands.
Long-deprecated APIs removed; Locator.ariaRef() and the exposeBinding handle option fail or are ignored, and videosPath/videoSize/logger options are ignored.
